tools.name: get_analysis
tools.description: Get one published Morereply analysis by its share token, its page URL (https://morereply.com/poll/{id}/stats/{token}) or a short link. Returns each demographic group's filter, voter count and option percentages, as stored when the author published it.

tools.name: get_poll
tools.description: Get one public Morereply poll by its id, its page URL (https://morereply.com/poll/{id}) or a short link (https://morereply.com/p/{code}). Returns the question, options, status, dates, total votes, and per-option votes and percentages when the poll shows results to visitors. A poll set to show result

tools.name: list_analyses
tools.description: List published analyses: saved breakdowns of a poll's result by demographic groups (age, gender, education, country and more). Give a poll id or URL to list that poll's analyses, or leave it out for the most recent ones. Use get_analysis to read one.

tools.name: search_polls
tools.description: Search public Morereply polls by words in the question or options, or by author username (@name). Returns up to 20 polls with status, vote totals and, where visitors may see them, option percentages. Only polls that are voting or closed are searchable. Use get_poll for one poll's full detail.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_analysis, get_poll, list_analyses · Private data: get_analysis · Public sink: get_analysis.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_analysis, get_poll, list_analyses · Private data: get_analysis · Public sink: get_analysis

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
